classification: writes/deletes financial-value meaning: deletes distinct adjacent amounts
what_changes: F-1, reproduced exactly per OCR_LEGACY_AUDIT.md: a run of [a,a,a,b,c] (three copies of $50.00, then the DISTINCT $75.00 and $60.00) collapses to [a] -- $75.00 and $60.00 are DELETED, not deduplicated, even though neither ever repeated
what_does_not_change: the surrounding lines X and Y
semantics_note: this is the worst input this census could construct for the whole nine-function chain: two genuinely distinct financial amounts are destroyed because they merely sat adjacent, in the same whitespace-separated run, to three copies of an unrelated value. `_MONEY_RUN_RE` consumes the ENTIRE run and `repl` substitutes the whole match, so this is not confined to what actually repeated
